heading: `judo.sh build` flag reference
proposed: `-KA` (skip Karaf) does not rebuild the `karaf-offline` package. `./judo.sh start` re-extracts that package on every start, so `build -F -KA` after Java changes leaves the running backend on the old custom operations. Drop `-KA` (or run `build -M -F`) before `start`.

heading: Resolution order (`DefaultActorResolver`)
proposed: The actor lookup runs after the `authenticate` hooks and before the operation body. A first call from a new user, with no actor row yet, fails with `AUTHENTICATED_ENTITY_NOT_FOUND` unless an `AuthenticationInterceptor.authenticate` hook has already created the row; a row created in `success` or in the operation body is too late for that request.
